body:
> Index · Summit Az · 2026-10-22

# Summary
Every note written from the Summit AZ work subfolders (`C:\TAG Marketing Claude\Summit Plumbing Pros\` subfolders, Arizona site summitplumbingpros.com), grouped by vault folder. Root files, the hub and the company profile are covered from [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub). EOD reports are in [EOD Reports Index](lib:brain-eod-reports-index).

Utah content found in these folders is flagged in the notes: `blogs\_utah_originals\` (5 Utah-site posts), three reused image filenames containing "utah", and the report finding that the relaunched site was built from a copy of the Utah site (GA data went to the Utah account Sep 3 to 10, hidden Utah info on the About page).
